clue.text: One's heart's a prisoner to it

definitions.text: One's heart's a prisoner to it

parts.words: One's heart's a prisoner to it
parts.note: the heart sits enclosed behind bars of bone, as if jailed by the structure of the chest

explanation.surface: A romantic lament about a heart held captive by someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The bony enclosure of the chest surrounds and protects the heart and lungs, like a cell around an inmate.

clue.text: Concentrated but looking embarrassed, cued poorly

parts.note: an embarrassed face turns red

indicators.note: poorly means badly done, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A snooker player concentrating but blushing after miscueing.
explanation.definitionFit: A sauce boiled down to concentrate its flavour is a reduced one.

clue.text: Pubs incorporating new buildings for storage

indicators.note: incorporating means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: bars are pubs

explanation.surface: Pubs taking in new premises to store goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Farm buildings for keeping grain, hay or animals are structures used for storage.

clue.text: Interviews nude, as ice dancing!

indicators.note: dancing suggests movement, so the letters are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A risque tabloid scene of nude ice dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal meetings with a monarch or pope are audiences, a kind of interview.

clue.text: Always catching lake fish when young

indicators.note: catching means holding inside, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: Someone who always caught fish at the lake as a child.
explanation.definitionFit: A young eel, an immature fish, is given this specific name.

clue.text: Very descriptive of poor/rich gap

indicators.note: poor suggests something done badly, so these letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A comment on how vividly the gulf between poor and rich is portrayed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' looks like half of the poor/rich pair, but it is the signal to rearrange RICH GAP.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing that is vivid and explicit in its detail is said to be very descriptive.

clue.text: Bravery from support structure protecting everybody

indicators.note: protecting means surrounding, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: a gantry is a framework that supports cranes or signals
all means everybody

explanation.surface: Courage displayed by a framework shielding the crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Courageous behaviour, especially in battle, is a near synonym for bravery.

clue.text: A useful quality when hardened

parts.note: as can mean when, as in as I left
set means hardened, like concrete or jelly

explanation.surface: A trait that becomes valuable once it has toughened.
explanation.definitionFit: A valuable attribute or resource is called an asset, a useful quality.

clue.text: Resident's final check on bingo call

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed after, below the other piece

parts.note: house is called in bingo when a full card is completed
checkmate, or mate, is the final check in chess

explanation.surface: A tenant making a last check on a bingo shout.
explanation.walkthrough: A HOUSEMATE is someone who shares a house with you.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone living in the same dwelling is a co-resident sharing the home.

clue.text: Italy invested in grant for such a tree

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, so one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: to confer is to grant
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Italy putting a grant into forestry.
explanation.definitionFit: A cone-bearing evergreen like a pine is a kind of tree.

clue.text: Read about Mephistopheles rash

indicators.note: about here means turned around or shuffled, so the letters of read are rearranged

parts.note: Mephistopheles is the devil of the Faust legend

explanation.surface: Someone studying Faust's tempter and finding him reckless.
explanation.definitionFit: A reckless person who takes wild risks is rash; the noun used attributively means foolhardy.

clue.text: Reject incentive point

parts.note: a spur is something that urges one on
N, north, is a compass point

explanation.surface: Turning down an offer of motivation at the key moment.
explanation.definitionFit: To scorn or turn down something offered is a synonym of rejecting it.

clue.text: A way into church offering social status

indicators.note: into tells us the first pieces are placed inside the abbreviation for church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
ST, street, is a way

explanation.surface: Going to church as a route to climbing the social ladder.
explanation.definitionFit: A hereditary class rank, as in the Hindu system, fixes a person's social standing.

clue.text: Oven-cooked grouse dish

parts.note: food cooked in an oven is roasted, roast as an adjective
a beef is a complaint or grouse

explanation.surface: A menu item of game bird baked in the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grouse' looks like the game bird, but it is a complaint, a beef.
explanation.definitionFit: Joint of cattle meat cooked in the oven is a traditional British Sunday dish.

clue.text: Something needed for drying out after freak accidents

indicators.note: freak implies something abnormal or twisted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: After some unusual mishaps, something to dry things off is required.
explanation.definitionFit: A drying agent such as silica gel absorbs moisture, which is what drying out requires.

clue.text: Agents trapped by criminal lies to a well-connected person

indicators.note: trapped by means held inside the other piece
criminal suggests something crooked, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the CIA is the US intelligence agency, a body of agents

explanation.surface: Spies caught out by a crook's lies to a person with friends in high places.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' rearranges LIES TO into SOLITE, and 'trapped by' puts CIA inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A person prominent in fashionable society mixes with the well-connected.

clue.text: Drunken binge — rue a pickled vegetable!

indicators.note: drunken suggests reeling about, so the letters of binge and rue a are jumbled

explanation.surface: A tipsy lament about a booze-up, with a joke about pickled veg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pickled' looks like a second anagram signal (slang for drunk), but it belongs to the definition: aubergines are often pickled, as in brinjal pickle.
explanation.definitionFit: The eggplant is a purple fruit eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Position of professor is key capital growth

parts.note: C is a musical key
hair grows on the head, and capital can mean head

explanation.surface: A financial question about where an academic's investments are growing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital growth' wants to be financial, but capital is the head and its growth is hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A professorship is called a chair, the seat of authority in a university department.

clue.text: Some left? Yes, of course

parts.note: certain means some, as in certain people

explanation.surface: Someone asking if anything is left, and being reassured.
explanation.definitionFit: Without doubt, surely, is the meaning of the affirmation of course.

clue.text: Careless broadcast shows needs

indicators.note: broadcast means spoken out, so the word is replaced by one that sounds the same

parts.note: lax means careless or slack

explanation.surface: A sloppy radio or TV programme reveals what is wanting.
explanation.definitionFit: To be without something, to want it, is a sense of needs as a verb.

clue.text: Better protected by circuits in computers

indicators.note: protected by means surrounded, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: laps are circuits of a track
to top is to better or beat

explanation.surface: Improving circuitry inside computers.
explanation.definitionFit: Portable machines used on one's knee are a type of computer.

clue.text: Partner's bone dry, if troubled

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone worried that their partner is completely parched.
explanation.definitionFit: A man in a romantic relationship is a partner to the other person.

clue.text: Mafia boss contains endless craving in prison

indicators.note: contains means holding inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a don is a Mafia boss

indicators.note: endless means the outer letters of the craving word are dropped

parts.note: hunger is a craving

explanation.surface: A gangster with insatiable desires finds himself behind bars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims the craving word at both ends, and 'contains' puts what is left inside the Mafia boss.
explanation.definitionFit: An underground cell in a castle was used as a prison.

clue.text: Hope game has primarily got something for devotees

parts.note: a prayer can be a hope or wish
RU, rugby union, is a game

indicators.note: primarily means at first, so only the opening letter of got is taken

explanation.surface: Someone hoping a game has gained something for its fans.
explanation.definitionFit: Small mat on which Muslim worshippers kneel, an item used by the devout.

clue.text: Incident in village's last outlet

indicators.note: last means only the final letter of the village word is taken

parts.note: a vent is an outlet for air or gas

explanation.surface: Something happening at the village's final shop.
explanation.definitionFit: An occurrence or happening is a synonym for an incident.

clue.text: Collapsed on top of lump hammer

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above, the first piece sitting on the second

parts.note: gave, as in gave way, means collapsed

indicators.note: top of means only the first letter of lump is taken

explanation.surface: A building collapsing onto a heap of rubble with a hammer.
explanation.definitionFit: A small mallet used by a judge or auctioneer is a kind of hammer.

clue.text: Garment or skirt for stage?

definitions.meaning: a protective covering worn over clothes when cooking
the part of a theatre stage projecting in front of the curtain

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a pinafore worn at the front and the strip of stage before the proscenium.

clue.text: Animal that's right at home in house

indicators.note: in signals one piece going inside another

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A creature that feels comfortable indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A large thick-skinned horned mammal of Africa and Asia is an animal.

clue.text: Ring, and yearn to express a view

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
to pine is to yearn

explanation.surface: Pining for a wedding ring and saying so.
explanation.definitionFit: To state one's opinion is the formal verb meaning to express a view.

clue.text: Creative and popular opening given, with no limits

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
a vent is an opening

indicators.note: with no limits means the outer letters of given are dropped

explanation.surface: A creative and popular start is granted without restriction.
explanation.definitionFit: Being original and full of new ideas is a synonym of being creative.

clue.text: Shade's a bit circumspect, really

indicators.note: a bit tells us only a portion of the words is taken, straddling them

explanation.surface: A ghost described as rather cautious in its behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: A shade is a ghost in literary usage, the same as a phantom or apparition.

clue.text: Cards on the table? Heard why party is in part of garden

indicators.note: is in tells us the sound and the party sit inside the garden part

parts.note: a lawn is part of a garden

indicators.note: heard means the word is spoken, so its sound gives a single letter

parts.note: the word why is said like the letter Y
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A garden party where someone asks why cards are being laid out.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge a lay-down hand is one so strong the player can show the cards and claim every trick.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand that wins regardless of play can be laid face up, cards on the table.
